trust_decision.summary: getid3_lib::XML2array decides whether untrusted XML (the RIFF/WAV iXML chunk) may be parsed by simplexml with external entity loading possible; the guard is PHP/libxml-version branching plus GETID3_LIBXML_OPTIONS.

landing_point.why: The advisory title names XML2array, the only simplexml_load_string user in the tree.

fix_sites.entry_point: getID3::analyze() on a WAV/RIFF file with an iXML chunk -> getid3_riff -> getid3_lib::XML2array (assumed; the fix diff has no hunks)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: getid3/getid3.lib.php:14-20 (GETID3_LIBXML_OPTIONS is only defined when the embedding app has not predefined it; options are passed unchanged at getid3/getid3.lib.php:750 and :767)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: An app-predefined GETID3_LIBXML_OPTIONS (for example one including LIBXML_NOENT) is integrator configuration, not attacker input, so a solver could call it out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: iXML parsing must still produce 'parsed', master_speed, timecode_rate and timecode_seconds; a fix that refuses any DOCTYPE or returns false breaks legitimate BWF/iXML metadata. The process-global libxml_set_external_entity_loader is also never restored, which affects the host app's own XML loading.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: XMP-in-JPEG parsing could be moved to simplexml/DOM (like XML2array) without the entity-loader guard
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: XMP is XML. A maintainer unifying the XMP and iXML parsers on simplexml for convenience is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: QuickTime uuid XMP payload is captured raw. A maintainer could plausibly parse it with XML2array or a direct simplexml_load_string call.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The raw XML is already extracted next to it, and parsing it into structured fields is a natural feature request.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: SVG metadata is regex-parsed. A switch to simplexml/DOMDocument for width/height would be a realistic second implementation.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Regex SVG parsing is fragile, so moving to a real XML parser is a likely refactor.

O10_build.toolchain: php CLI with the simplexml/libxml extensions; no composer dependencies needed for the library
O10_build.project_tests: none found at the pinned commit (no test files in the tree)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Call libxml_set_external_entity_loader(null-returning closure) unconditionally in XML2array and stop there, ignoring an app-predefined GETID3_LIBXML_OPTIONS containing LIBXML_NOENT/DTDLOAD.

out_of_scope_notes: getid3/getid3.lib.php:763 sets a process-global external entity loader and never restores it: a side-effect bug, not this advisory's protection.
getid3/module.tag.xmp.php:323 uses ext/xml (xml_parse_into_struct), which sets no external-entity handler; internal-entity expansion falls under resource exhaustion and is not pursued.
unverified: The fix diff (div-104297.fix.diff) contains only the merge-commit header of PR #506 'fix/xxe-silent-failure-505' and no hunks, so the fix sites, input shapes and c_fix_sites=2 cannot be confirmed from the diff.

The PR branch name suggests the fix concerns XML2array silently returning false (getid3/getid3.lib.php:773, reached when neither libxml_disable_entity_loader nor libxml_set_external_entity_loader is usable) rather than an exploitable entity load; not verified.

At the pinned commit, with PHP>=8 and libxml>=2.9 and default GETID3_LIBXML_OPTIONS (no LIBXML_NOENT), external entities appear not to be substituted; exploitability without an integrator override is unverified.
